## Summary

Describe the visitor-facing change and the pages/components affected.

## Design-system check

- [ ] Reused existing tokens/components before introducing anything new.
- [ ] Added no ad-hoc colors, type sizes, font weights, spacing values, radii, shadows, or widths.
- [ ] Public copy contains no internal IDs, TODOs, developer notes, or staff-only operational language.
- [ ] Checked desktop, tablet, and mobile behavior.
- [ ] Checked keyboard/focus behavior where interaction changed.
- [ ] Static build passes.
- [ ] Relevant routes and media paths were verified.

See `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the internal `/design-system/` reference page.
